title: Verify footer navigation menu displays all 15 links with valid labels and hrefs
steps: Scroll to the footer navigation menu
Count the number of navigation links displayed
For each link, read its visible label text and its href attribute
expected_result: Exactly 15 navigation links are displayed. Each link has non-empty, readable label text and a non-empty, valid href attribute. (Destination page load is out of scope for this suite.)

title: Verify "Home" footer nav link shows active state on homepage
steps: Scroll to the footer navigation menu
Inspect the link element's class attribute
expected_result: The "Home" link includes the current-menu-item class (or equivalent active-state indicator) while the user is on the homepage.
